observations.text_written:
You could consider Sourcey as another option. It allows you to generate a static documentation site directly from an OpenAPI or swagger specification. If you already have an OpenAPI file, the workflow is basically: sourcey build api.yaml

This generate the API reference as static files in the output directory, and you can host the result on any static web host such as GitHub Pages. It supports both OpenAPI 3.x and Swagger 2.0 and also allows you to integrate Markdown guides and other documentation sources into the same site.

https://sourcey.com/oss
